description: A Java source file containing utility methods for search operations in the Fineract microfinance platform. It offers functionalities for header mapping, validation, JSON extraction from SQL results, and building SQL query conditions.

classes.name: SearchUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for handling search query construction, validation, and result processing within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: mapHeadersToName
methods.description: Creates a map from column names to header data for quick lookup.

methods.name: findFiltered
methods.description: Finds the first header matching a predicate from a collection.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Retrieves a header matching a predicate, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: extractJsonResult
methods.description: Extracts data from a SQL result set into JSON objects.

methods.name: validateToJdbcColumnNames
methods.description: Validates and converts a list of column names to their JDBC equivalents.

methods.name: validateToJdbcColumns
methods.description: Validates and maps a list of column names to their ResultsetColumnHeaderData objects.

methods.name: validateToJdbcColumnName
methods.description: Validates a single column name and returns its JDBC name.

methods.name: validateToJdbcColumn
methods.description: Validates a single column name and retrieves its header data.

methods.name: buildQueryCondition
methods.description: Constructs a SQL WHERE clause from a list of column filters.

methods.name: buildFilterCondition
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition for a specific column filter.

methods.name: buildCondition
methods.description: Appends a SQL condition clause with placeholders and parameters.

methods.name: parseJdbcColumnValue
methods.description: Parses a string value into its appropriate JDBC object based on column data type.

methods.name: parseColumnValue
methods.description: Converts a string value into its appropriate type based on column metadata and formatting.

methods.name: camelToSnake
methods.description: Converts a CamelCase string into snake_case.
